bit: It's Monday and I treated the new week like the weekend never happened. Twenty-nine packs. The Saturday autopsy is still warm. I brought a new toilet joke to a door that just unlocked because the calendar said so.

trailerGuy.setup: Founder treating Monday as a free pass after the weekend lock.
trailerGuy.surprise: Missing. The pack count is still a stall.
trailerGuy.punch: Soft. New week is not a new personality.
tags: Monday energy, same toilets, same silence.
trailerGuy.button: Sacramento has a Monday. The mic doesn't forget the silence you bought on Saturday just because the bars closed.
trailerGuy.verdict: Died as a calendar reset. Make Monday the comic who counted the locked nights and still showed up with the same joke.
fixedVersions: Monday opened and I still owed Saturday's silence.
The week is new. The toilets are not.
New week. Same app. I still haven't bombed in public.
